verdict.rationale: CrewAI is itself a first-party Python SDK/framework (Agent, Task, Crew, Flow classes) with extensive official docs, an installable CLI, YAML config, and a REST API (kickoff/status/resume) for enterprise deployments, all clearly documented as the core building blocks developers code against. Community evidence confirms real developers build agent pipelines directly against these APIs. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Python (e.g., JS/TS or other languages), and stronger independent/hands-on validation of SDK stability at scale.
